summary: Studio City International Holdings filed a 6-K disclosing receipt of a NYSE notice of non-compliance with Section 802.01C of the NYSE Manual after its ADSs averaged a closing price below US$1.00 over 30 consecutive trading days. The company has a six-month cure period ending April 27, 2027, and intends to notify the NYSE of its plan to regain compliance. ADSs continue trading during the cure period; remediation options are under consideration. Watch for a reverse split or other price-support action, and any acceleration of delisting risk if compliance is not restored.
